name: AI Readme Generator
description: Generates a README.md for an installed contrib/custom module by scanning its code and summarising it with an AI provider (OpenAI or Groq).
project_description: The AI README Generator module automatically generates a README.md file for any installed contrib or custom Drupal module. It scans the selected module's code (via the innoraft/ai-readme-generator PHP package's CodebaseScanner) and sends the collected metadata to an AI service (OpenAI or Groq) to produce a structured README, which it writes into the module's directory. It ships two admin forms — an AI configuration form (provider, API key, model) and a Generate-README form (pick a module, click Generate) — plus a Drush command 'readme-generate <module>'. Useful when preparing modules for contribution on Drupal.org, documenting internal custom modules, or doing codebase cleanup, without hand-writing README files. Requires a valid API key and the PHP package innoraft/ai-readme-generator (installed via Composer).
